note: Anguilla: a work permit under the Control of Employment Act. Executive Council exempts visiting bands and artistes by name for particular events under section 3(g) (Moonsplash, 2016); an exemption decided event by event isn't modelled as days. British citizens and the other territories' passports, though of the same nationality, need it too and are named; the territory's own are home.

sources.title: Government of Anguilla, Minutes of the 46th Meeting of the Eleventh Executive Council, 14 April 2016, EX MIN 16/234
sources.said: agreed that the members of the bands and musical artistes named on the ... attached list should be exempted from the requirement of a work permit in ... accordance with Section 3 (g) of the Control of Employment Act.
